implementationRules.mobile: 20 px gutters; four hero photos in one row, emblem below; stats in one column; services number and toggle above heading, expanded image beside copy; project cards stacked. implementationRules.rails: Scroll viewport reaches the section edges. Put grid gutters inside the rail before first and after last item.

When stacked, use normal layout gaps and show errors in flow, on both desktop and mobile. Do not add page-specific reservation flags.

notes: Measured in the Chrome Figma Properties panel. Frame heights are reference measurements, not fixed CSS page heights.
